extraction.Name: Nora Sway Sanders
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat recorded 11-20-18 by First National Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Joseph A. Skinner for $500; SEl 36-38-34 deeded to James R. Duff, Pierce, by Nora Sway Sanders and Jesse F. Sanders for $2550.00 on May 9, 1919
